---
title: "Download ADFRsuite"
---

ADFR is distributed as part of the **ADFR software suite** (ADFRsuite), which contains everything
needed to set up docking experiments for small molecules and peptides.

## ADFRsuite 1.0 rc1

Release candidate 1 of ADFRsuite 1.0 contains:

- ADFR 1.2 and associated scripts
- AGFR 1.2
- AutoSite 1.0 and 1.1
- ADCP 1.0
- AutoGrid 4.2
- `prepare_ligand`
- `prepare_receptor`

| Platform | Installer | How to install |
|---|---|---|
| Linux 64-bit | [installer app](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr/download/1028/) | `chmod a+x ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.0_install`<br>`./ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.0_install` |
| Linux 64-bit | [tarball](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr/download/1038/) | see [Installing from a tarball](#installing-from-a-tarball) |
| macOS | [tarball](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr/download/1033/) | see [Installing from a tarball](#installing-from-a-tarball) |
| Windows | [installer app](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr/download/1067/) | double-click the downloaded installer |

### Installation notes

- The commercial installation does **not** install MSMS, the component that computes molecular
  surfaces. For a commercial MSMS license contact [Dr. Michel Sanner](mailto:sanner@scripps.edu).
  All other tools in the suite work fully in both installations.
- The default install location is `~/ADFRsuite-1.0`. If your home folder is not on a local disk,
  install to a folder on a local disk for better performance.
- ADFRsuite ships its own Python interpreter (2.7), installed in the `ADFRsuite-1.0` folder. It is
  isolated from your system Python and does not interfere with it. Start it with
  `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin/pythonsh`.

### Installing from a tarball

This example uses the macOS tarball; for another tarball change the file and folder names.

```bash
# unpack the tar file
tar zxvf ADFRsuite_x86_64Darwin_1.0.tar.gz

# step into the folder created by unpacking
cd ADFRsuite_x86_64Darwin_1.0

# run the installation script
#   -d destinationFolder  where to install ADFRsuite 1.0
#   -c                    how to compile the Python files: 0 for .pyc, 1 for .pyo
./install.sh -d myFolder -c 0
```

### Known issues

**Linux 64-bit with older versions of GCC:**

```
ImportError: /usr/lib64/libstdc++.so.6: version `GLIBCXX_3.4.15' not found (required by ADFRsuite-1.1/lib/python2.7/site-packages/_openbabel.so)
```

To fix the error:

```bash
cd <InstallationDir>/ADFRsuite-1.0/lib
mv libstdc++.so.6.orig libstdc++.so.6
```

## ADFRsuite 1.1 (development version)

A development build of ADFRsuite 1.1 is available for Linux 64-bit:
[ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.1dev_Install](https://sourceforge.net/projects/adfrsuite/files/ADFRsuite-1.1dev/ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.1dev_Install/download)
(SourceForge). Install it like the 1.0 installer app:

```bash
chmod a+x ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.1dev_Install
./ADFRsuite_Linux-x86_64_1.1dev_Install
```
